doc.brief: The QGraphicsSceneWheelEvent class provides wheel events in the graphics view framework.
doc.index_brief: Wheel events in the graphics view framework

QPoint pixelDelta() const.brief: Returns the scrolling distance in pixels on screen.

QPoint screenPos() const.brief: Returns the position of the cursor in screen coordinates when the wheel event occurred.

QPointF pos() const.brief: Returns the position of the cursor in item coordinates when the wheel event occurred.

QPointF scenePos() const.brief: Returns the position of the cursor in scene coordinates when the wheel event occurred.

Qt::KeyboardModifiers modifiers() const.brief: Returns the keyboard modifiers that were active when the wheel event occurred.

Qt::MouseButtons buttons() const.brief: Returns the mouse buttons that were pressed when the wheel event occurred.

Qt::ScrollPhase phase() const.brief: Returns the scrolling phase of this wheel event.

bool isInverted() const.brief: Returns whether the delta values delivered with the event are inverted.

int delta() const.brief: Returns the distance that the wheel is rotated, in eighths (1/8s) of a degree.
